a: Story files are keyed by platform paths but looked up by vite's posix ids, so on Windows story updates, prop controls and through-reindexing never match
A type imported under another name gets its definition filed under the original name
A conditional type nested in a conditional's check or extends position prints without parentheses
b: Story files keyed by native paths are compared with vite's `/`-separated ids, so prop controls, API tables and `forge:story` never fire on Windows
`fileEventsArrive` arms a bare `setTimeout` with the caller's `waitMs`, so a long or infinite wait reports "no events" at once
The issues endpoint accepts any array of objects as a list of issues, then answers rows with missing fields
